what: The brief said lane disk2-1111 (serve/settle.rs, store format 5) and harness/v2/agents.py were in the integration tree; int-1112 held neither, so the design was read from origin/disk2-1111 with git show and the build could not start.
cost: about twenty minutes finding which branch held each file, and one round trip before building
cause: the brief was written from what was planned to be merged, not from the tree
workaround: git show origin/disk2-1111:<path> into /tmp and designed against that
fix: a brief names the commit that holds each file it cites, checked with git ls-tree before it is sent
whys: the brief stated a merge as done
the merge was queued behind other lanes
nothing checks a brief paths against the tree it names
prevention: integrate.py prints, for a brief, each cited path with whether the integration tip has it
